The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] [[Rallo]] ran a '''workshop''' in a [[Gus Talon settlement|settlement]] on [[Gus Talon/Legends|Gus Talon]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. It was the location of a [[Lightfight|firefight]] between Rallo's men and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. It was soon after [[Bombing of Gus Talon|destroyed]], along with the rest of the [[City/Legends|city]], by Imperial [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]].
